sloka: मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यां वाक्यं मम पितुस्तदा ।न श्रुतं वीर्यमत्तेन तस्येदं फलमीदृशम् ।। ६.११४.७८ ।।
transliteration: mārīcakumbhakarṇābhyāṁ vākyaṁ mama pitustadā ।na śrutaṁ vīryamattena tasyedaṁ phalamīdṛśam ।। 6.114.78 ।।

translations.english: "O Ten headed king! You did not heed the good words of advice given by your friends. You did not totally heed the good words spoken by your brothers."
